hooks.command: bash -c 'set -o pipefail; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && listing=$(find tether-vault \( -name .git -o -name .obsidian -o -name .venv -o -name .claude -o -name node_modules \) -prune -o -type f -print | sort) && jq -Rn --arg body "$listing" '\''{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "SessionStart", additionalContext: ("Vault file listing (recursive from tether-vault/, repo-relative paths):\n" + $body)}}'\'''
